# Breathing Color

> > Archival inkjet media manufacturer specializing in fine-art paper, canvas, and cotton-rag products for professional photographers and artists.

Breathing Color is a Texas-based manufacturer of premium archival inkjet media, offering cotton-rag fine-art papers, baryta papers, canvas, and printing supplies with ICC color profiles for optimal print quality. The company serves fine-art photographers and artists seeking archival-quality, museum-grade printing materials.

## Key Topics

- Archival Quality
- Cotton Rag Paper
- Fine-Art Printing
- ICC Profiles
- Color Management
- Baryta Paper
- Print Media
- Vibrance Baryta
- Pura Smooth
- Optica One
- Photo Paper
- Matte Finish
- Elegance Velvet
- Print Longevity
- CIE L*a*b* Color Space
